content: To answer these questions, we have reimplemented several strategies to use monolingual data in NMT and have run experiments on two language pairs in a very controlled setting (see § SECREF2 ). Our main results (see § SECREF4 and § SECREF5 ) suggest promising directions for efficient domain adaptation with cheaper techniques than conventional BT.
